description: This file defines the 'MidiOutputPortSelector' class which manages MIDI output port selection, device opening, and message dispatching within an Android application.

classes.name: MidiOutputPortSelector
classes.description: A class to select and manage a MIDI output port and send MIDI messages via this port within an Android activity.

methods.name: MidiOutputPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the selector with MIDI manager, activity context, and UI element ID.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles action when a MIDI port is selected; opens device and output port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes MIDI port and device, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns a MidiSender for transmitting messages via the selected port.
